description: Connect your own Odoo CRM so your discovered prospects sync into it. Provide your Odoo URL, database name, API-user id and API key (generate one under Preferences -> Account Security -> New API Key). The connection is validated live against your Odoo before it is saved; your API key is stored encrypted and is NEVER shown back — present a masked confirmation (e.g. odoo_api_key: ****) to the user. Calling this again updates the existing connection.

credentials.description:
A customer's own Odoo CRM connection details.

Mirrors the ``POST /api/v1/tenant/odoo-connection`` request body the odoo-sync
onboarding router expects (``_validate_shape``) field-for-field — the endpoint
contract is the single source of truth, so we do NOT invent a divergent schema.

``customer_id`` is deliberately absent: identity is the JWT-derived
``X-Customer-Id`` header set at the gateway, so a customer can only ever set
THEIR OWN credentials. The connector adds no validation of its own — the live
``/jsonrpc`` auth probe + SSRF guard + FK audit all run server-side before
anything is stored (a thin bridge; business logic lives behind the gateway).

``odoo_api_key`` is a SECRET: it is sent in the request body (never a query
param, never logged) and is never echoed back — the gateway + odoo-sync
response filters strip it, so any confirmation the agent shows must mask it.

enrichment_stage_id.description: Optional stage FK for leads still needing contact enrichment (validated live).

lead_type.description: Optional Odoo lead type, defaults to 'opportunity' server-side.

odoo_api_key.description: Your Odoo API key (generate under Preferences -> Account Security -> New API Key). SECRET: stored encrypted, never logged, and never echoed back.

odoo_db.description: Your full Odoo database name, including any '-scm-NNNN' suffix (Odoo.sh).

odoo_uid.description: The numeric id of the Odoo API user (visible in the Odoo URL on the user form).

odoo_url.description: Your Odoo base URL, e.g. 'https://acme.odoo.com' (https; validated for SSRF safety server-side).

stage_id.description: Optional CRM stage FK for new leads (validated live against your Odoo).

name: set_odoo_credentials
title: Connect Odoo CRM
